title: Wintermute — Vanity Address Private Key Compromise (Profanity Tool) Analysis
root_cause: Wintermute's DeFi operational address was generated using the Profanity vanity address tool, which used a 32-bit random seed (instead of 256-bit), making the private key recoverable via GPU brute-force in ~70 GPU-hours
vulnerable_contract: Wintermute hot wallet (vanity address generated by Profanity tool)
code_before:
❌ Profanity PRNG (simplified pseudocode)
# Seed was only 32-bit random (system time or similar)
seed = random.randint(0, 2**32 - 1)          #

❌ Only 32-bit entropy

# Derive private key from seed via repeated hashing
private_key = seed
for _ in range(N):
    private_key = keccak256(private_key)      # Deterministic from 32-bit seed

# With ~4 billion possible seeds, GPU brute-force finds private key in ~70 GPU-hours

#
code_after:
✅ Secure address generation
# Use 256-bit cryptographically secure random seed
private_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)         # 256-bit CSPRNG
address = eth_account.from_key(private_key).address
